# ARDAS Home Health Care — Bathinda, Punjab, India

> ARDAS Home Health Care is a professionally managed home healthcare provider in Bathinda, Punjab, India, serving families since 2023. Background-verified caregivers, nurses, patient attendants, physiotherapists and babysitters provide care at patients' homes, plus lab test sample collection at home. Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98770 62683. Email: info@ardashomehealthcare.com. Address: Guru Ki Nagri, Bathinda, Punjab 151001, India. Office hours: Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–5 PM IST; urgent assignments are often arranged within 4–6 hours and most within 24 hours.

## Services (all delivered in Bathinda, Punjab)
- [Elderly Care at Home in Bathinda](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/elderly-care-bathinda.html): ARDAS Home Health Care provides background-verified elderly caregivers in Bathinda who help ageing parents with daily living, mobility, medication reminders and companionship — so seniors stay safe, dignified and comfortable in their own homes. Caregivers are usually assigned within 24 hours.
- [Home Nursing Services in Bathinda](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/home-nursing-bathinda.html): ARDAS provides qualified home nurses in Bathinda for clinical care prescribed by your doctor — injections, IV and catheter care, tube feeding, wound dressing, bedsore care and vitals monitoring — delivered safely in the patient's own home.
- [Patient Attendant Services in Bathinda](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/patient-attendant-bathinda.html): ARDAS provides trained, background-verified patient attendants in Bathinda who help patients with personal hygiene, feeding, mobility, positioning and everyday care — at home or in hospital — on day, night or 24-hour shifts.
- [Post-Surgical Care at Home in Bathinda](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/post-surgical-care-bathinda.html): Recovering from surgery is the most delicate phase of treatment. ARDAS provides post-surgical care at home in Bathinda — wound-care assistance, medication reminders, mobility support, nutrition help and daily monitoring — so patients heal safely after hospital discharge.
- [Physiotherapy at Home in Bathinda](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/physiotherapy-bathinda.html): ARDAS brings physiotherapy to your home in Bathinda. Our home-visit physiotherapists help patients recover after surgery, rebuild movement after stroke or paralysis, and manage back, knee and joint pain — without the struggle of travelling to a clinic.
- [Babysitter Services at Home in Bathinda](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/babysitter-services-bathinda.html): ARDAS provides trained, background-verified babysitters in Bathinda for newborns, infants and toddlers — attentive feeding, hygiene, safe play and sleep-time care in your own home, on part-time, full-time or night schedules.
- [Lab Test Facility at Home in Bathinda](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/lab-test-at-home-bathinda.html): Skip the queue at the lab. ARDAS arranges lab test sample collection at your home in Bathinda — a trained phlebotomist visits your doorstep, collects the sample safely, and digital reports are shared with you on time.
- [Careers & Job Application Form](https://www.ardashomehealthcare.com/careers.html): ARDAS is actively hiring verified caregivers, home nurses (GNM, ANM, B.Sc Nursing), patient attendants, babysitters, and physiotherapists for day, night, and 24-hour live-in assignments across Bathinda. Candidates can submit their application form, Aadhaar card, and qualification certificates online.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: Does ARDAS provide home healthcare services in Bathinda?
A: Yes. ARDAS Home Health Care provides elderly care, home nursing, patient attendants, post-surgical care, physiotherapy, babysitter services and lab test facility at home in Bathinda.

Q: How quickly can I get a caregiver in Bathinda?
A: Most requirements are fulfilled within 24 hours. Urgent cases may be arranged within 4 to 6 hours, subject to availability and care requirements.

Q: How much does home healthcare cost in Bathinda?
A: Pricing depends on the type of service (caregiver, nurse, attendant, physiotherapist or babysitter), the shift — day, night or 24-hour live-in — the patient's condition and the duration of service. ARDAS shares a clear, transparent quote before service begins. Call or WhatsApp +91 98770 62683 for current rates.

Q: Do you provide 24-hour live-in caregivers in Bathinda?
A: Yes. ARDAS offers day-shift, night-shift and 24-hour live-in caregivers, patient attendants and nurses, subject to availability.

Q: Which areas of Bathinda do you serve?
A: We coordinate services across Bathinda city — including Model Town, Ajit Road, Mall Road, Civil Lines, Power House Road, Thermal Colony, Bibi Wala Road, Amrik Singh Road, Guru Ki Nagri, Ganesha Basti — and nearby towns such as Rampura Phul, Maur Mandi, Talwandi Sabo, Nathana, Sangat, Bhucho Mandi, Goniana.

Q: What is the difference between a patient attendant and a home nurse?
A: A patient attendant helps with non-clinical daily care such as hygiene, feeding, mobility and companionship. A home nurse handles clinical procedures — injections, catheter and tube care, wound dressing and vitals monitoring — as prescribed by a doctor.

Q: I live outside India. Can I arrange care for my parents in Bathinda?
A: Yes. Many NRI families arrange elderly care through ARDAS. You can book by phone or WhatsApp, and we keep families updated about ongoing care.

Q: Can care start on an urgent or same-day basis?
A: Urgent requirements can often be arranged within 4 to 6 hours, subject to staff availability and care needs. Most assignments are fulfilled within 24 hours.

Q: What are the payment options?
A: ARDAS accepts cash, UPI and bank transfer. Payment terms are shared clearly before the service starts.

Q: Are ARDAS caregivers verified?
A: ARDAS caregivers undergo identity and background verification, medical fitness checks, training and ongoing supervision before and after deployment.
